title: Git LFS evidence pointers
responsibility: Formats and recognizes LFS pointer text and selects the media extensions stored through LFS.

inputs.name: lfsPointer.file
inputs.description: Original SHA-256 digest and byte count to place in the pointer text.

inputs.name: parseLfsPointer.text
inputs.description: Text to match against a three-line version, SHA-256 object id and decimal size pointer.

inputs.name: lfsStored.path
inputs.description: File path whose final extension determines LFS storage, case-insensitively.

outputs.name: lfsPointer
outputs.description: Three-line Git LFS pointer with the standard version URL, supplied digest and size, and a final newline.

outputs.name: parseLfsPointer
outputs.description: Parsed digest and numeric byte size, or undefined when the pointer shape does not match.

outputs.name: lfsStored
outputs.description: True for png, jpg, jpeg, webp, gif, wav, mp3, m4a, ogg, webm and mp4 extensions.

outputs.name: lfsAttributes
outputs.description: Git attributes lines applying LFS filtering to lowercase and uppercase forms of each supported media extension.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown when lfsPointer receives a null or undefined file object, or when parseLfsPointer or lfsStored receives a value that cannot convert to text, such as a symbol.
